originalIdentity: An exposed human apparition with tousled gray-brown hair, clean-shaven youthful face, dark eyes and a sorrowful expression. Blue-gray scarf and blue-gray/brown leather armored coat, brown shoulder straps with small brass round fasteners, brown belt and hip pouch. Two bare empty hands. Limbs and lower trouser/coat remnants dissolve into warm ochre-gold translucent curling wisps, with a few small close-floating fragments. No skull face, hood, horns, staff, sword or physical shield.
equipmentIdentity: Both hands are empty in every original frame. The apparent gold fragments and fading lower body belong to the original ghost silhouette; the independent ghost-touch effect remains a separate topic.
symbolReview: No sacred or faction emblem observed. Brass strap fasteners, buckle and pouch details are costume hardware, not invented runes. Warm ochre-gold edges are contained ghost-body styling, not an external glowing aura.
originalFrameReview: Original idle and third attack are nearly identical upright hovering poses. Walk-a and walk-b show different arm extension and curled drifting lower-leg/wisp phases. The figure does not have ordinary planted boot contacts; lower limbs fade into connected wisps. Preserve hover semantics rather than adding a grounded infantry gait.

independentAssets.policy: Keep equipment icon and independent ghost-touch FX separate. No attack beam, impact burst or full-canvas fog baked into the unit.

alphaContract: The source depicts a spectral faded body with gold-rim wisps. Original HD alpha is largely opaque in the central body (idle 2073 alpha255 pixels among 3657 nonzero); partial alpha is common near edges and particles. Do not claim original interior was uniformly semitransparent. Coordinator explicitly requests intentional bounded body translucency in the remake; empty canvas and limb/wisp gaps must remain truly alpha0, with no pervasive haze.
footprintClarification: Original art frame32x48, anchor[16,47], footprint[1,1]. Rule flying/unarmored semantics remain unchanged. Hover registration uses an explicitly estimated virtual support anchor at the lower connected wisp, not fictitious boot contact.

scaleProposal.rationale: A human-sized apparition with exaggerated broad head and hands consistent with the approved chunky family. Its lower body is a connected wisp silhouette rather than planted boots. Measure coherent crown-to-attached-wisp extent from the idle, with a documented alpha threshold suited to actual intentional translucency, then lock one scale for all poses. Floating detached fragments do not determine body height.
